curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8020-1/ (scans; the file builds the yellow truck, pages 2-5, steps 1-14; the van, windmill and others after)

functions.does: The wheel on the cab roof steers the front wheels: an 8-tooth gear at the foot of its axle turns a crown gear behind the windscreen, which turns an 8-tooth gear on a cross axle, which slides the toothed rack that joins the two steering arms.
functions.source: book: steps 2 and 4-6 (rack, 8-tooth gears and crown gear) and 13 (the roof wheel on its axle with an 8-tooth gear)

functions.does: The four road wheels roll freely, the front ones on pins in the steering arms, the rear ones on pins in the chassis.
functions.note: inferred: nothing is driven from the wheels
